title: MLS 102 - Blood Specimens, Microbiology and Urinalysis

items.q: Which term is described by “the cloudiness of a urine sample seen when it is held to the light”?
o: Dipstick
Urinalysis
Proteinuria
Turbidity
items.s: Turbidity is the cloudiness of a urine sample seen when it is held to the light.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Distilled water?

the red pigment of blood that carries oxygen from the lungs

the cloudiness of a urine sample seen when it is held to the light
items.s: Distilled water: water purified by vaporisation and condensation for laboratory use. The other options describe Turbidity, Glycosuria, Haemoglobin.

items.s: Differential count: the counting of each type of white cell in a stained film. The other options describe Control chart, Platelet, Blood group.

items.s: Decolourizer: the reagent that removes dye from some cells during a differential stain. The other options describe Gram stain, Fasting specimen, Cross-match.
